headline: SRM Contractors files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: SRM Contractors concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: SRM Contractors Limited has officially submitted its scrutinizer's report following the Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also disclosed the final voting results for the resolutions presented to shareholders. This filing completes the procedural requirements for the company's annual governance cycle.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: SRM Contractors announces a change in its management team
summary: SRM Contractors Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a change in its management. The company operates in the construction and infrastructure sector, executing road and tunnel projects primarily in Jammu and Kashmir. Investors in the company should track further disclosures regarding the specific roles affected and incoming personnel. Leadership transitions can influence operational execution and strategic direction for small-cap infrastructure firms.
whats_next: Detailed exchange filing on management changes
why_it_matters: Management shifts may impact project execution for retail holders.
